schema_version.description:
Manifest format version. The loader accepts exactly this version and
never migrates an older file in place.

environment.description:
Deployment environment. Selects test-only affordances; it does not relax
runtime manifest validation.

path.description:
SQLite catalog file. Relative paths resolve from the manifest directory.
":memory:" is rejected because the catalog must survive a restart.

listen.description:
Local socket the application listener binds, as host:port or :port.
Never a URL, and never given a port implicitly. 127.0.0.1 is loopback
only; 0.0.0.0 is every IPv4 interface; [::] is every IPv6 interface.

cors_allowed_origins.description:
Extra browser origins allowed to make credentialed cross-origin calls,
such as a local Vite dev server. Empty for a same-origin SPA deployment.

web_root.description:
Directory of built SPA assets. Empty serves the API alone, which is what
the Vite development profile wants.

mode.description:
Whether this process serves plaintext HTTP or obtains its own ACME
certificate. External proxies use mode = "off" for the upstream.

hostname.description: Public certificate hostname. Non-empty if and only if mode = "acme".

http_listen.description:
Socket for the ACME HTTP-01 challenge and the plain-HTTP 308 redirect to
the ACME hostname. Non-empty if and only if mode = "acme".

email.description: ACME account contact address. Non-empty if and only if mode = "acme".

storage_path.description:
Persistent directory for certificates and ACME account state. Must be
machine-local state outside storage.path. Non-empty iff mode = "acme".

trusted_cidrs.description:
CIDRs whose immediate TCP peer may supply X-Forwarded-For. This controls
client-IP recovery only; reverse-proxy access never depends on this list.

level.description: Minimum level emitted to both sinks.

dir.description: Directory for rotated log files. Relative paths are manifest-relative.

file_format.description: Encoding for the on-disk log files.

repository_audit_verbose.description:
Log every repository scan decision. Useful when diagnosing ingestion, far
too noisy for normal operation.

path.description:
Portable media root holding the .lumilioroot marker and repository
directories. This is the mount users back up and migrate.

cloud_state_path.description:
Cloud provider sessions and credential artifacts. Machine-bound private
state, so it must resolve outside storage.path.

backups_path.description:
Database backup destination. Also machine-bound, also outside
storage.path, so that backing up media does not capture secrets.

enabled.description: Whether to periodically reconcile repositories against the catalog.

settle_seconds.description: Seconds a file must stay unmodified before it is considered complete.

provider.description:
Reverse-geocoding backend. "disabled" keeps coordinates local and makes
no network calls.

nominatim_endpoint.description: Nominatim reverse endpoint. Read only when provider = "nominatim".

language.description: Preferred language for returned place names.

user_agent.description:
User-Agent presented to the provider. Public Nominatim requires a real
contact string in its usage policy.

access_token_ttl.description: Access token lifetime as a Go duration, for example "15m".

refresh_token_ttl.description: Refresh token lifetime, and therefore the session cookie lifetime.

enabled.description:
Whether WebAuthn is offered on secure request origins. HTTP LAN addresses
remain usable with password and TOTP but cannot use passkeys.

name.description: Relying-party display name shown in the browser prompt.

ip_attempts.description: Failed attempts allowed per client IP inside one window.

subject_attempts.description: Failed attempts allowed per account inside one window.

window.description: Rolling window over which attempts accumulate.

lockout.description: How long a subject stays locked after exhausting its budget.

max_entries.description: Tracked entries held in memory, bounding the limiter's footprint.

hardware_accel.description:
Hardware video acceleration backend. "auto" probes what the host offers
and falls back to software; "none" forces software transcoding.

discovery_enabled.description:
Whether to look for external Lumen ML nodes at all. ML stays optional;
false keeps the deployment entirely local.

discovery_mdns_enabled.description:
Discover nodes over mDNS on the local link. Containers usually cannot,
so Docker deployments prefer a hub URL or static nodes.

discovery_hub_url.description:
Absolute http(s) URL of a Lumen hub. May be empty when mDNS or static
nodes already supply the node list.

discovery_static_nodes.description: Explicit host:port Lumen nodes, tried regardless of discovery results.

deployment_id.description: Label identifying this deployment in Lumen logs and node affinity.

resolve_timeout.description: Timeout for resolving a discovered node's address.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout for opening a connection to a resolved node.

rediscovery_backoff_min.description: Shortest wait before retrying discovery after a failure.

rediscovery_backoff_max.description: Longest wait between discovery retries. Must be >= the minimum.

scan_interval.description: Interval between periodic node health sweeps.

chunk_auto.description: Let the client choose chunked upload automatically by payload size.

chunk_threshold_bytes.description: Payload size in bytes above which chunking kicks in.

chunk_max_bytes.description: Bytes per chunk. Must be <= chunk_threshold_bytes.

exiftool_path.description:
exiftool binary. A bare command is looked up on PATH; anything holding a
path separator is resolved relative to the manifest.

ffmpeg_path.description: ffmpeg binary, resolved by the same rule.

ffprobe_path.description: ffprobe binary, resolved by the same rule.

title: Lumilio Photos runtime manifest (schema v3)
description: Complete runtime configuration. There are no code defaults, no configuration file search, and no environment-variable overrides: every key below must be present in the file.
